description: SEC Central Index Key (unique company ID)
Standard Industrial Classification code (use for peer comparisons)
control = no widely reported accounting action; reference = publicly reported restatement/SEC action (weak label, verify)
Short description of the reported event for reference-group companies
Fiscal year, from company fiscal-year-end (52/53-week aware)
Calendar quarter label (e.g. 2021Q3) for cross-company alignment
Length of the quarter in days (84-112 typical)
Revenue. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: Revenues | RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax | ...IncludingAssessedTax | SalesRevenueNet | SalesRevenueGoodsNet | SalesRevenueServicesNet | RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense

description: Cost of revenue. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: CostOfRevenue | CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold | CostOfGoodsSold | CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciationDepletionAndAmortization | CostOfServices; else revenue - gross_profit

description: Gross profit. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: GrossProfit; else revenue - cost_of_revenue

description: Sga. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense

description: Rnd. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense | ...ExcludingAcquiredInProcessCost

description: Operating expenses. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: OperatingExpenses

description: Costs and expenses. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: CostsAndExpenses

description: Operating income. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: OperatingIncomeLoss

description: Net income. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: NetIncomeLoss | ProfitLoss | NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic

description: Depreciation. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization | DepreciationAndAmortization | DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet | Depreciation

description: Cfo. Amount for the period as first reported (discrete quarter in quarterly file; full year in annual file)
Accounts receivable. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: AccountsReceivableNetCurrent | ReceivablesNetCurrent

description: Inventory. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: InventoryNet

description: Current assets. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: AssetsCurrent

description: Total assets. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: Assets

description: Ppe net. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet

description: Current liabilities. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: LiabilitiesCurrent

description: Total liabilities. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: Liabilities; else LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity - equity

description: Long term debt. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: LongTermDebtNoncurrent | LongTermDebt

description: Equity. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: StockholdersEquity | StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest

description: Cash. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue | CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents

description: Deferred revenue. Balance at period end, as first reported
source_or_formula: us-gaap tags in priority order: ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent | DeferredRevenueCurrent
